title: Participant - Data API
description: Represents a participant in a ConversationParticipant. An existing or new Participant is referenced each time a new ConversationParticipant is created. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

ParticipantAppType.description: The type of app used by the participant, such as messaging, chatbot, live_message, agent.

ParticipantRole.description: The role of this participant in the conversation, such as System, Agent, Chatbot, EndUser, Supervisor, or Router.

ParticipantSubject.description: The subject of this participant in the conversation.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="Participant">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="ConversationParticipants" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="ParticipantAppType" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ParticipantRole" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ParticipantSubject" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="QueryLocator">
  <restriction base="xsd:string"/>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="QueryResult">
  <sequence>
    <element name="done" type="xsd:boolean"/>
    <element name="queryLocator" type="tns:QueryLocator" nillable="true"/>
    <element name="records" type="ens:sObject" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
    <element name="size" type="xsd:int"/>
  </sequence>
</complexType>
```
